caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man rendered in a brown, wood-like texture, shown against a plain, light beige background. The bust includes the head, neck, shoulders, and upper chest. The man has a partially bald head with hair extending to the sides and back, detailed facial features with visible wrinkles, and an intense gaze directed slightly to the left. Cracks and grain on the surface suggest the bust is made of aged wood. The bust is dressed in formal attire, including a jacket with large buttons and a high ruffled shirt at the neck. The shading and highlights enhance the three-dimensional and carved appearance of the bust. There are visible lines and textures throughout, emphasizing the material’s worn condition.
title: Figurehead: Benjamin Franklin
